findings.resolution: Authority-sensitive consumers rerun the verifier from full current policy, registry, implementation, artifact, raw graph, normalized graph, ontology/profile and caller-pinned identities; no bare verification receipt is accepted.
Missing envelope fields and verification failures are blocking in a dedicated release-only channel while legacy analysis remains available; aggregate failure cannot partially promote accepted edges.

The parser is explicitly a canonical-edge artifact parser, every path remains ANALYSIS_ONLY with the upstream-capture gap, release_eligible is always false and the global release interlock remains enabled.

Typed tests cover disallowed states, missing/disabled/rotated extractors, implementation and artifact tamper, duplicate and malformed graphs, direction reversal, cross-root inputs, expiry/future time, renamed sources and input permutations.
Artifact locators are repository-relative and reject absolute, traversal, ADS/colon, control, reserved-device and trailing-dot-or-space forms without exposing sensitive input.
Upstream capture attestation, historical normalizer replay, durable anchoring and complete R0.2-R0.5 release inputs remain explicit and prevent capability promotion beyond FOUNDATION.
